title: Hidden in Plain Sight
summary: There aren't too many Victorian windows, replete with divided-light, fixed upper sashes, that have a 100-metre-tall-plus crane behind them, but in Toronto, you never know what's behind a restored heritage wall. While 8 Elm continues its ascent to 69 storeys and 218.2m on our Downtown skyline, that monster will remain in place. Afterwards, bike storage and mechanical space on the second floor, and community facilties on the third, all in a brand new reinforced concrete shell.
